description: Fetch a specific filing's metadata and document content by accession number. Returns the primary document as readable text. Use offset/next_offset for multi-page access to large filings (10-K, S-1 can exceed 1M chars): pass the next_offset from a truncated response to read the next page. Use section to jump directly to a heading (e.g. 'risk factors', 'item 7') without needing an offset.

accession_number.description: Filing accession number in either format: "0000320193-23-000106" (dashes) or "000032019323000106" (no dashes). Obtained from secedgar_company_search or secedgar_search_filings results.

cik.description: Company CIK, digits only (resolve via secedgar_company_search if you have a ticker or name). Optional but recommended — speeds up archive lookup. If omitted, likely filing CIKs are inferred from SEC search metadata and archive paths.

content_limit.description: Maximum characters of document text to return per page. 10-K filings can exceed 500,000 characters; S-1/A can exceed 1,000,000. Default 50,000 captures ~12,000 words (typically business overview, risk factors, and MD&A). Increase to 200,000 for full financial statements, or decrease for quick summaries. Use offset or section for subsequent pages.

document.description: Specific document filename within the filing (e.g., "ex-21.htm" for subsidiaries list). Default: the primary document. Available documents are listed in the response metadata under documents; entries marked binary hold no text and are rejected.

include_xbrl.description: Include XBRL viewer artifacts and machine-readable taxonomy files (R*.htm fragments, *_cal/_def/_lab/_pre.xml linkbases, *_htm.xml inline instance, *.xsd schemas, MetaLinks.json, FilingSummary.xml, Show.js, report.css, *-xbrl.zip, Financial_Report.xlsx, EX-101.* technical exhibits) under documents.xbrl. Off by default — these dominate filing indexes (~100 entries on a typical 10-K) and are rarely relevant when reading filing content.

offset.description: Character offset into the extracted document text. Pass next_offset from a truncated response to continue reading the next page. Default 0 reads from the beginning.

section.description: Jump to a named section by case-insensitive substring match against detected headings (e.g. 'risk factors', 'item 7', 'certain relationships'). A value ending in a number matches only that number: 'item 1' reaches Item 1 and Item 1A, never Items 10–16. Matching also ignores whitespace and quote-style differences, so a heading copied from the outline resolves whether it carries the filing's non-breaking spaces and curly quotes or plain ones. Takes precedence over offset when both are provided. On a miss, the error message includes the detected outline so you can pick the correct heading.

name: secedgar_get_filing

accession_number.description: Filing accession number, normalized to dash format.

cik.description: Filing entity CIK, zero-padded to 10 digits.

company_name.description: Filing entity name. Absent if the CIK did not resolve to a known entity.

content.description: Document text content for this page window.

content_truncated.description: True if content was truncated at content_limit.

documents.description: Filing documents by category. Any name is a valid document input except entries with binary: true, which fail with binary_document; scans can outnumber readable documents.

auxiliary.description: Other supporting documents: cover pages, consent letters, graphics.

items.description: One document entry from the filing.

binary.description: True for a binary entry (scan, PDF, archive, spreadsheet); absent otherwise.

description.description: SEC description (e.g., "Subsidiaries of the Registrant"). Absent when none.

name.description: Document filename within the filing archive.

type.description: SEC document type (e.g., "10-K", "EX-21.1", "GRAPHIC"), or without a submission header a filename-inferred label ("exhibit", "PDF", "unknown").

exhibits.description: Filed exhibits (EX-21, EX-31/32, EX-99, etc.), excluding XBRL EX-101.*; without a submission header, matched by filename (type "exhibit"), the rest under auxiliary.

type.description: SEC document type (e.g., "10-K", "EX-21.1", "GRAPHIC"), or without a submission header a filename-inferred label ("exhibit", "PDF", "unknown").

primary.description: Primary document(s), typically one entry whose type matches the form.

binary.description: True for a binary entry (scan, PDF, archive, spreadsheet); absent otherwise.

description.description: SEC description (e.g., "Subsidiaries of the Registrant"). Absent when none.

name.description: Document filename within the filing archive.

type.description: SEC document type (e.g., "10-K", "EX-21.1", "GRAPHIC"), or without a submission header a filename-inferred label ("exhibit", "PDF", "unknown").

xbrl.description: XBRL viewer artifacts and taxonomy files. Present only when include_xbrl=true.

items.description: One document entry from the filing.

binary.description: True for a binary entry (scan, PDF, archive, spreadsheet); absent otherwise.

description.description: SEC description (e.g., "Subsidiaries of the Registrant"). Absent when none.

name.description: Document filename within the filing archive.

type.description: SEC document type (e.g., "10-K", "EX-21.1", "GRAPHIC"), or without a submission header a filename-inferred label ("exhibit", "PDF", "unknown").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `document_not_found`: A specific document was requested but not present in the filing archive. `no_documents`: Filing index lists items but no fetchable primary document was found. `binary_document`: The requested document is a binary entry (scanned image, PDF, archive) with no text to return. `filing_not_found`: No filing matches the accession number under any candidate CIK. `offset_out_of_range`: The provided offset is at or beyond the end of the document. `section_not_found`: The section string did not match any detected heading in the document. `rate_limited`: SEC is rate-limiting this server's IP — SEC answered 429, or the call was refused without being sent while the cool-down after one runs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filing_date.description: Date the filing was submitted (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent under the same conditions as form.

filing_url.description: Direct URL to the filing on SEC.gov.

form.description: Form type (e.g., "10-K"), from the submissions feed or the filing's SEC header. Absent only when neither has it.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page, to pass as offset; present while content_truncated is true.

notice.description: How to read the next page, and which file was read when the archive does not serve the indexed primary.

outline.description: Up to 50 headings, on the first page of a truncated response (offset=0, no section); pass a heading offset as offset, or its text as section.

items.description: One detected heading with its offset.

offset.description: Character offset of this heading in the full document; pass as offset.

period_ending.description: Period of report (YYYY-MM-DD), from the same source as form. Absent for forms without one (S-8, Form 4, proxy statements) or when neither source has it.

primary_document.description: Filename of the primary document. When the archive does not serve the one the index names (common in 2000–2001), this is the full submission file <accession>.txt instead; the notice names both.

requested_document.description: Filename requested via document. Present only when it differs from primary_document.

shown.description: Characters of document text returned on this page.

truncated.description: True when the document is longer than `content_limit` allowed through.
